# DupLec 07 — alternatives to choose from {background-color="#2c3e50"}

## What this deck is

This is a **holding deck**, not part of the workshop. It collects the **alternative / duplicate figure renderings** that were pulled out of [Lecture 07 — Functional Analysis](Lecture_07_FunctionalAnalysis.html) so the main deck stays tight (~15–20 min).

-   Each slide below is an **alternative version** of a figure that already appears in the live Lecture 07.
-   Under each one, *"Live deck uses:"* names the figure currently shown in Lecture 07 for that concept.
-   This file is **not linked from the Materials page**. To swap one in, move the slide back into `Lecture_07_FunctionalAnalysis.qmd`.
